title: Benefit Overpayment Accounts — Changed-Plan Months by Remaining Principal
content:
When the monthly installment of a current repayment plan on Benefit Overpayment Accounts is changed, the changed-plan months follow the principal still unpaid.

| Remaining principal | Changed-plan months |
|---|---|
| Up to USD 1000.00 (the small-remainder cap) | The small-remainder share, 0.2 (20 percent), of the classification's maximum plan months |
| Above USD 1000.00 and up to USD 3000.00 (the mid-remainder cap) | The mid-remainder share, 0.4 (40 percent), of the classification's maximum plan months |
| Above USD 3000.00 | The classification's maximum plan months in full |

Each share is counted in whole months, with any fraction of a month dropped.

**Remaining principal.** The principal assessed less the principal recovered by repayments, benefit offsets and tax refund intercepts and the principal removed by waiver, cancellation and write-off adjustments, plus the principal put back by returned repayments and refunds.

## Schedule by classification

| Classification | Maximum plan months | Up to USD 1000.00 | Above USD 1000.00 up to USD 3000.00 | Above USD 3000.00 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error | 60 | 12 | 24 | 60 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Employer Reporting Error | 60 | 12 | 24 | 60 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Appeal Reversal | 60 | 12 | 24 | 60 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error | 48 | 9 | 19 | 48 |
| Fraud Overpayment — First Offense | 36 | 7 | 14 | 36 |
| Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense | 24 | 4 | 9 | 24 |

*Hypothetical:* a Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error account with USD 4,000.00 of principal assessed, USD 1,500.00 recovered by offsets and USD 200.00 put back by a returned repayment has USD 2,700.00 remaining; 40 percent of 48 months is 19.2, so 19 changed-plan months.
